'''Stack Substances''' is the index of the Van Kush Family Research Institute's substance monographs — every plant, compound and enzyme that appears in the Institute's own stacks, formulations and botanical inventory, written up individually so that each can be checked on its own terms.

Every entry states what is '''established''', what is '''preclinical''', and what is the '''Institute's own hypothesis''', separately. Where a substance has a real hazard, the hazard is on the page rather than in a disclaimer.

== Why the interactions are stated in full ==

These pages carry preparation detail, dose figures where the literature gives them, and interaction and contraindication warnings in full. That is deliberate and it is the Institute's settled position: '''withholding preparation, dose and interaction detail from someone who is going to proceed anyway is the harm this library exists to prevent.''' Somebody deciding what to do with a pound of ''Mucuna'' extract is better served by being told plainly that L-DOPA plus an MAOI is a hypertensive-crisis interaction than by being told to consult a professional about a plant most professionals have never handled.

== The endocannabinoid framework ==

The organising idea across most of the botanical inventory:

* '''[[Cannabinoid Oilahuasca]]''' — the framework itself: potentiate the body's own cannabinoids by inhibiting the enzymes that clear them, on the model of DMT plus an MAO inhibitor
* '''[[MAGL]]''' — the enzyme that clears 2-AG, ~85% of it
* '''[[FAAH]]''' — the enzyme that clears anandamide
* '''[[Anandamide and 2-AG]]''' — the two endocannabinoids, and why they are not two versions of one thing
* '''[[Endocannabinoid Chemistry and 2-AG Metabolism]]''' — 2-AG biosynthesis via DAGL, spontaneous 1,2-acyl migration to 1-AG, Noladin ether, and virodhamine
* '''[[Cannabinoid Adducts and Conjugates]]''' — chlorinated adducts, macromolecular dimers, Phase II fatty acid conjugation, and cyclodextrin complexes

== Enzyme systems, inhibitors, and biological regulators ==

Monographs detailing enzymatic kinetics, metabolic cascades, synaptic clearance, and macromolecular inhibitors:

* '''[[The Expanded Endocannabinoid System and FAAH Science]]''' — the endocannabinoidome (eCBome), catalytic Ser-Ser-Lys triad, PEA/OEA signaling, BIA 10-2474 forensics, and C385A genetics
* '''[[Cytochrome P450 System Inhibition and Induction]]''' — CYP3A4/2D6/1A2/2C9/2C19 kinetics, mechanism-based suicide inhibition (grapefruit/piperine), PXR/AhR induction, and prodrug vs active drug divergence
* '''[[Bioavailability: Metabolic Enzymes, Transporters, and Synergistic Delivery]]''' — oral bioavailability equations ($F=f_a \times F_g \times F_h$), Ayahuasca MAOI lesson, grapefruit furanocoumarin suicide inhibition, Racetam/Choline/Alpha-GPC kinetics, Phenylpiracetam lipophilicity, Vitamin C redox shielding, and kitchen synergists (vanillin, cinnamaldehyde, turmeric/piperine 2000% boost, S-acetyl glutathione, ethanol)
* '''[[Sublingual Absorption, Salivary Enzymes, and Mucosal Bioavailability]]''' — non-keratinized sublingual mucosa, internal jugular first-pass avoidance, salivary $\alpha$-amylase and lingual lipase, MUC5B/MUC7 barriers, saponin and terpene permeation drivers, and Henderson-Hasselbalch pH partition shifts
* '''[[Ubulawu, African Oneirogens, and Saponin Pharmacokinetics]]''' — Southern African dream root science (*Silene undulata*, *Helinus integrifolius*, *Synaptolepis kirkii* kirkinine), biosurfactant micro-foams, salivary amylase inhibition, and convergence with Oilahuasca, Ukuphahla, Egyptian Head Cones, and Punic Wax
* '''[[Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors and Neurotransmitter Systems]]''' — MAO-A vs MAO-B, irreversible vs RIMA (harmalas), dietary tyramine cheese effect, and serotonin syndrome pharmacology
* '''[[Cholinergic Neurotransmission and Cholinesterase Inhibition]]''' — why intact ACh has no reuptake pump, AChE velocity, CHT1 rate-limiting bottleneck, galantamine, huperzine A, and organophosphate aging
* '''[[Enzyme Inhibition Kinetics and Molecular Transporters]]''' — Lineweaver-Burk models (competitive, non-competitive, uncompetitive, suicide), the serine hydrolase superfamily, SLC6 transporters (SERT/DAT/NET), and VMAT2
* '''[[Bacteriophages Endolysins and Biological Inhibitors]]''' — phage biology, holin-endolysin lytic machinery ("enzybiotics"), bacterial CRISPR defenses, Anti-CRISPR (Acr) biological protein inhibitors, and phage-antibiotic synergy
* '''[[Virology, Antivenom Immunology, and Aromatic Antimicrobials]]''' — chlorine radical photolysis, active vs passive immunity, F(ab')2 antivenom fragments, convalescent plasma, and Thieves Oil protease / zinc ionophore enzymology

== The interactions worth knowing before anything else ==

* '''L-DOPA + MAOI''' — hypertensive crisis. [[Mucuna Pruriens|Mucuna]] with any harmala-containing preparation, syrian rue, or a prescribed MAOI.
* '''MAOIs/RIMAs + Serotonergic agents (SSRIs, SNRIs, MDMA, DXM, Tramadol)''' — fatal serotonin toxicity. Requires strict 2-to-5 week drug washout intervals; see [[Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors and Neurotransmitter Systems]].
* '''Irreversible MAOIs + Aged food tyramine ("Cheese Effect")''' — severe hypertensive crisis and stroke from displaced peripheral norepinephrine; see [[Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors and Neurotransmitter Systems]].
* '''Piperine / Grapefruit + Prescription medications''' — mechanism-based and competitive inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP2D6 and P-glycoprotein causes toxic blood accumulation of narrow-therapeutic-index drugs; see [[Cytochrome P450 System Inhibition and Induction]].
* '''Cholinesterase inhibitors (Galantamine, Huperzine A) in cardiac conduction disease''' — stimulates cardiac M2 receptors, risking severe bradycardia, AV block, and syncope; see [[Cholinergic Neurotransmission and Cholinesterase Inhibition]].
* '''Kava + alcohol, sedatives, or anything hepatic''' — see [[Kava]].
* '''8-PN in hormone-sensitive conditions''' — see [[8-Prenylnaringenin]].
* '''Folate without checking B12''' — see [[L-Methylfolate]].
* '''B6 above ~100&nbsp;mg/day''' — irreversible sensory neuropathy; see [[B-Vitamins]].
* '''Vitamin K2 with warfarin''' — direct antagonism of the drug's mechanism; see [[Vitamin K2]].
* '''Galantamine with bradycardia, asthma or an anticholinergic''' — see [[Galantamine]].
* '''Chronic complete MAGL inhibition''' causes CB1 desensitisation. More is not better; see [[MAGL]].
* '''Vaporizing acetate prodrugs (THC-O-acetate, Vitamin E acetate)''' — coil temperatures >200&nbsp;°C pyrolyze esters into toxic ketene gas (CH2=C=O), causing severe acute chemical pneumonitis and pulmonary edema; see [[Cannabinoid and Tryptamine Prodrugs]] and [[Airway Irritation and Cannabinoid Prodrug Delivery]].
* '''Unwashed acid-isomerized extracts''' — inhaling residual mineral acids (HCl, H2SO4, pTSA) or chlorinated adducts causes acute airway destruction; see [[Cannabinoid Isomerization]] and [[Cannabinoid Adducts and Conjugates]].
* '''Space Paste or heavy nutmeg abuse''' — toxic anticholinergic-like delirium and possible DNA-reactive 1'-hydroxy sulfate metabolites; see [[Shulgin Ten Essential Amphetamines and Metabolic Chemistry]].
* '''Open-blasting volatile hydrocarbon solvents (butane/propane)''' — catastrophic fuel-air thermobaric explosions; butane pools along floors (vapor density 2.08 g/L) and ignites at just 1.8% LEL from refrigerator relays, static electricity, or pilot lights; see [[Laboratory Equipment and Extraction Engineering]].
